verdict.rationale: AWS documents official getting-started tutorials, including onboarding tasks, a tutorial to build and deploy a React app with Amplify, and a tutorial to host a simple website, plus an official CLI install guide. Nothing in the pack shows these tutorials list the exact commands or get a new developer from zero to a running service in under an hour. Missing for 10: evidence that quickstarts show exact copy-paste commands, any time-to-first-deploy claim or measurement, independent hands-on corroboration of a fast first deploy.

support.subject: As a developer, first deploy is under an hour — official quickstarts that go from zero to a running service with the exact commands shown

citations.quote: If you're a beginner looking for a starting point to learn AWS, we recommend that you complete the following six onboarding tasks.
Learn how to build and deploy a React web application with user authentication, a database, and storage using AWS Amplify.
Learn how to host your personal or simple marketing website on AWS.
